hints.title: Alternating Parity Jump Success Propagation
hints.text: From each starting index, alternating odd jumps (to smallest >= value) and even jumps (to largest <= value) determine if the end index can be reached.

hints.title: Monotonic Order Index Jump Resolution
hints.text: Sort indices by value to find odd jump targets using next greater index. Sort indices by value descending to find even jump targets.

hints.title: Dynamic State Propagation Blueprint
hints.text: Compute odd_next and even_next arrays using sorted index container scans. Work backwards from n - 1: odd[i] = even[odd_next[i]] and even[i] = odd[even_next[i]]. Return sum of odd[i].

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting indices by values dominates runtime at O(N log N); monotonic index resolution runs in O(N).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning forward for each jump takes O(N) leading to O(N^2) overall time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorted index passes compute next jump targets for all nodes simultaneously.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Transforming value comparisons into index-monotonic ordering via sorting.
